proposals.name: The Night Ballet
proposals.why: A ballet is a dance that is seen and heard at once, and the guardians who work by night move together as one body, so the name asks the panel to be judged as a dance and not as a list of opinions.

proposals.name: Pulse and Line
proposals.why: Musicality and clean line are what I ask of every design, and this name keeps the count you can hear and the edge you can follow, which is all a panel of eighteen needs to stay in step.

proposals.name: The Round Dance
proposals.why: A round dance is the oldest way a people moves as one, each dancer keeping their place in the ring and the circle carrying them, and that is how these eighteen judge, with no one stepping out ahead.
